answer: Each agent’s influence can be capped by a scarce, nontransferable stake that is slashed when independent audits confirm coordinated deception. To gain sway, a sybil attacker must lock real capital behind every identity; cloning accounts no longer multiplies voting power for free. Randomly selected auditors compare claims across an echo of interactions, while a shale-thin history or a canyon of near-identical behavior can trigger review. The attacker risks losing stake and pays an ongoing opportunity cost for each fake identity.
